returns.index: The storage index of the newly added batch.

addBatch((address,bytes)[],uint256).details: Reverts if another batch was added in the meantime, so the      caller can rely on the returned index matching what it encoded into its proposal.

params.calls: Non-empty array of (target, calldata) pairs to store.
params.expectedIndex: The index the caller expects this batch to occupy.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

params.accounts: Non-empty array of batcher addresses to revoke.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAccessControlManager(address).details: Admin function to set address of AccessControlManager

params.accessControlManager_: The new address of the AccessControlManager

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

__gap.details: This empty reserved space is put in place to allow future versions to add new variables without shifting down storage in the inheritance chain.

InvalidBatchIndex(uint256,uint256).notice: Thrown when the caller-provided index does not match the index the batch would be stored at.

NotAllowedToBatchCommands(address).notice: Thrown when an unauthorized account tries to add a batch.

Unauthorized(address,address,string).notice: Thrown when the action is prohibited by AccessControlManager

ZeroAddressNotAllowed().notice: Thrown if the supplied address is a zero address where it is not allowed

NewAccessControlManager(address,address).notice: Emitted when access control manager contract address is changed

accessControlManager().notice: Returns the address of the access control manager contract

addBatch((address,bytes)[]).notice: Append a new batch of calls.

addBatch((address,bytes)[],uint256).notice: Append a new batch of calls, asserting it is stored at `expectedIndex`.

batchCount().notice: Returns the number of batches stored; the next addBatch() call will use this as its index.

batches(uint256,uint256).notice: 2-D array of pre-seeded call batches; index 0 is the first batch added.

executeBatch(uint256).notice: Execute every call in batch `index` sequentially.

getBatch(uint256).notice: Return all calls stored in batch `index`.

initialize(address).notice: Initializes the contract with the AccessControlManager.

removeAuthorizedBatchers(address[]).notice: Revoke accounts' authorization to call addBatch.

userdoc.notice: Stores pre-seeded batches of generic on-chain calls and executes them in one go,         reducing the calldata footprint of governance proposals that would otherwise exceed         GovernorBravo's gas limit when encoding many large-array parameters.
